_about: John Conington (1825-1869), Corpus Professor of Latin at Oxford. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot, 2026-10-10): Miscellaneous Writings, ed. J. A. Symonds with a memoir by H. J. S. Smith (1872), vol. I, raw IA OCR. Vol. II is almost wholly his prose Virgil, which the virgil shelf already holds (virgil-conington-works-1880), so it is not added. His translations of Horace, Virgil and Persius are on those shelves. His Virgil commentary (with Nettleship) reads 0.73 on the OCR measure, under the bar. No uids minted.
